evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform

notes: Tuition fee is stated in USD, which is the currency the programme page uses for this programme. The application deadline is given without a year; it is a recurring deadline. The application channel quote refers to the online application platform, which is the university's direct application route for self-financed applicants.

note.fr: Le certificat de fin d'études secondaires doit être en anglais ou traduit.
note.en: The school-leaving certificate must be in English or translated.

evidence.quote: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated)
